newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Cos unit says manages $25 bln.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Cos unit says manages $25 bln.

text.p: Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc, a subsidiary of The Equitable Cos Inc, said Tuesday it closed 1996 with $25 billion in mortgages and real estate under management, including about $14 billion for pension funds and international clients.
It said most of its portfolios scored double digit performance gains led by its Value Enhancement Fund I, a $500 million pooled pension fund account that had a 32.6 percent return for the year.
Equitable did not give comparable figures and its officials were not immediately available for comment.
